## File: settings-ignore-menu.yaml
## Type: project menu
## Purpose: Menu for managing ignored file extensions and related
## ignore-list features used by ingestion and tooling.

metadata:
  udi: prismata.universe.menu.settings-ignore
  name: "Settings > Ignore Menu"
  version: "0.1.0"
  kind: menu
  description: "Submenu for managing ignored file extensions."

menu-items:
  - menu-key: "1"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.ignore.add"
    label: "Add Ignore Extension"
    description: "Add a file extension (e.g. .mid, .wav) to the ignore list. Stored in settings.ignore_extensions."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-ignore"
    args:
      action: "add"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - menu-key: "2"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.ignore.remove"
    label: "Remove Ignore Extension"
    description: "Remove an extension from the ignore list."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-ignore"
    args:
      action: "remove"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null

  - menu-key: "3"
    udi: "prismata.universe.menu.settings.ignore.list"
    label: "List Ignore Extensions"
    description: "Show currently configured ignored file extensions."
    capability: "prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-ignore"
    args:
      action: "list"
    ui_framework: basic
    submenu_ref: null
